Discover the science behind why gastrointestinal viruses such as the norovirus is more stable and transmissible in cooler, less humid conditions, and learn what you can do to stay healthy. Why do stomach bugs spike in the cooler months? As temperatures drop, cases of gastrointestinal viruses like norovirus increase.
